answer: Before the ships come in the dusk stair keeper climbs to the signal mast and ties the boat and scans the horizon before the fog horn sounds. The keeping is backed by Harbor flame lighter chamber ledger: a ledger flame lighters witness after chamber gallery checks. The anchor counts the flashes, the marble times the flashes, the ivory notes the weather. Forging that logbook needs 2447 false logbooks and 2447 false signals to hold.
